verdict.rationale: The axis applies because Kong exposes its own Admin and Konnect APIs, but the pack documents neither a versioning scheme for those APIs nor a deprecation policy. The OpenAPI directory, go-kong's semantic versioning (which covers an SDK, not the API), and the AI Gateway v2 migration guide are adjacent material only. None of them establishes versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
